criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slide 2 is the best render in the deck; 4 a convincing relief; 1 and 9 stage the cyan tower in a pool against dark racks. Weak: 7 a straight-on flat grid in the grey middle with the eight a sliver at feed size; 3 straight on, carrier under the dek, lifted charcoal field; 8 a pale mid-grey floor with a hard-edged lighter rectangle on it, rod-cage racks, cables under the footer; 6 the same floor rectangle, skeletal rod frame; 5 subject in the lower 45 percent, necks and SNAREs small.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hall world, one cyan meaning, a measured motif and the tower changing state across 6, 8 and 9. Two grades (3 and 7 lifted charcoal against navy black), copper with two meanings, no bridge from 5 to 6.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral checked has a claim; hedges hold. Sources are HPCwire reprints of TACC releases; the cover's background rack total not verified at this resolution. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where; no decision, body or action; the stake only in the caption's closing question; Horizon without a date.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe; 2 steps back; 3 restates the cover; the turn at 6 lands; the close lands though its dek restates the count.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, careful attribution; slide 8's deks lean on release phrasing; Texas specificity stops at institution names; no house rule breaks.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Repeats no. 72's dark room plus relief mix, molecular model and raised-row grid; the data hall and cyan node motif are new.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild 3 and 7 as physical objects in the hall's own world, lit by the same flood with a three quarter camera.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Straight-on flat grid in the grey middle; the eight a sliver at 432 px.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: High three quarter view, one flood pooled on the eight, far rows to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Straight-on carrier jammed under the dek on a lifted charcoal field.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the carrier 120 px, navy black field, turn the camera 20 to 30 degrees.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Pale mid-grey floor, a hard-edged lighter rectangle on it, rod-cage racks, cables under the footer.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the floor rectangle, pull the flood tight, end the cables before the footer.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The same hard-edged floor rectangle; skeletal rod frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Delete the floor artifact; solid side panels.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Subject in the lower 45 percent; necks and SNAREs small.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Push in 1.4x on the neck; crop the arc off the top and sides.
